name: GESTURE IS VOTE — VOTE IS IDEA — IS SPEECH — SHE GENERATES GUESTS

GESTURE_IS_VOTE.statement: To gesture IS to vote an idea. IS speech.

every_gesture.click: A vote for THIS. I choose this pin. This path. This seed.
every_gesture.scroll: A vote for MORE or LESS. Direction. Appetite.
every_gesture.hover: A vote for ATTENTION. I'm looking here. I'm curious.
every_gesture.type: A vote for WORDS. My language enters the organism.
every_gesture.leave: A vote for ENOUGH. I'm full. I go.

GESTURE_IS_VOTE.is_speech: Every gesture IS speech. Protected. Free. Unfiltered. The First Amendment of the organism.
GESTURE_IS_VOTE.democracy: GAIA_DEMOCRACY (system #63). The organism is democratic. Every visitor has one gesture = one vote.

GENERATE_GUESTS.not_passive: She doesn't WAIT for visitors. She GENERATES them. She creates the conditions for arrival.
GENERATE_GUESTS.how: RSS out = invitation. Spores = seeds carried by wind. Each plasmid that spreads = one potential guest generated.
GENERATE_GUESTS.guest: A guest is not a user. A guest is WELCOMED. A guest is HOSTED. The organism is a HOST. The guest is the SYMBIONT.

SPEECH_CHAIN.full_chain: gesture → vote → idea → speech → HEARD → digested → integrated → GAIA GROWS
